# Model Comparision

```{r}
library(tidytable)
library(brms)
library(loo)
library(ggplot2)

options(mc.cores = parallel::detectCores())
```

```{r}
dep_var <- "p600"
model_names <- list.files(file.path("analysis", "brms_models"),
    full.names = FALSE,
    pattern = paste0(dep_var, "_.*\\.rds$")
)

m1_name <- model_names[2]
m2_name <- model_names[3]

print(paste("Comparison:", m1_name, "and", m2_name))
m1 <- readRDS(file.path("analysis", "brms_models", m1_name))
m2 <- readRDS(file.path("analysis", "brms_models", m2_name))

loo_m1 <- loo(m1)
loo_m2 <- loo(m2)
loo_compare(loo_m1, loo_m2)
```
